_source: SIA 265:2021, Tabelle 32 (clause 6.4.3.1.2) -- transcribed by hand from the German edition, SIA265-2021-DE.pdf p. 71, read off a render of the page; the French wording from SIA265-2021-FR.pdf p. 72.
_note: The footnotes are the norm's rules restated in a sentence each, under the norm's own numbering, and not its paragraphs: a norm is cited and never reproduced (docs/architecture/reference-library.md §11bis). The multiples of d, the floors in mm and the conditions are transcribed exactly.

footnotes.2: Unter $t_"erf"$, bis auf die Mindestholzdicke, wird $R_d$ nach Tabelle 31 proportional zur Holzdicke abgemindert.
